title: BYD Local Marketing Site
shortDescription: BYD's local marketing site was static and hard-coded. I rebuilt it as a dynamic platform with a backoffice behind it.
fullDescription: BYD is an electric vehicle brand, and its local marketing site started as a static page, every image and line of content hard-coded into the templates. I rebuilt it as a dynamic platform end to end, backoffice included.

sections.content: BYD's local marketing site started as a static page, every image, text block and number hard-coded into the templates. Any change meant editing code, so the team behind the brand had no way to update the site themselves.

sections.imageAlt: The BYD marketing site landing page

sections.content: I took on turning that static site into a dynamic platform. The goal was to move content out of the code and into data that non-developers could manage, without losing the clean, brand-first look of the public site.

The core of the solution is a backoffice that gives site admins control over content. News, contacts, agencies, car models: each has its own management screen to add, edit, remove and reorder, no code required.
sections.imageAlt: Backoffice navigation for managing site content

sections.content: The public site reads all of it from dynamic data now. Sections render from structured content, so a change made in the backoffice shows up on the live site as soon as it's published.
sections.imageAlt: Dynamic content driving the public site

sections.content: News gets its own management flow. Admins can publish, unpublish and edit announcements, and the marketing page picks up the latest stories automatically, no developer needed for a simple update.

As an EV brand, the site also needed to make the case for going electric. The economy simulator handles that: a calculator that lets visitors compare costs and see the savings of driving an EV, with every parameter configurable from the backoffice.
Car models are managed the same way. Each model's images, videos, specs and pricing are structured content in the backoffice, so the lineup can grow and change without a code deploy.
sections.imageAlt: BYD car models configured through the backoffice
A BYD model page rendered from dynamic data

sections.content: Agencies and contacts work the same way. Showrooms, service partners and contact points are managed as data, so the dealer network stays accurate as it grows.
sections.imageAlt: Agencies and contacts managed as dynamic data

sections.content: The result is a site the team can run without a developer for day-to-day changes. News, contacts, agencies, models, media and the simulator are all editable from the backoffice, and the public site keeps the same polished, brand-first look it had before.

footer.note: End-to-end rebuild of a static BYD marketing site into a dynamic platform with a content backoffice.
